svg.text: U9: STM32C011F4P6, 3.3 V; internal oscillator; 16 KB flash / 6 KB RAM.
20 kHz PWM, input debounce, restart latch, ramp and overload timer.
I2C reads the active fixed 15 V contract; invalid contract disables U2.
Reset/watchdog: PWM and nSLEEP pulled low; U2 inhibited. No USB data.
U10: 3.3 V AND gate; MCU request AND hardware HEALTH.
HEALTH low asynchronously sends U6 to coast, independent of firmware.
U2/U5 ready + fault, U6 fault, U8 thermal outputs are open drain.
J5 tscircuit JST PH SWD pin order:
VTREF is sense-only; power board via USB-C.
